concepts.prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. This is original high-quality production concept art for Helicoptea, a cozy physics flight game about palm-sized, mechanically serious scale aircraft performing tea-making and cargo acrobatics in a real human kitchen and garden. Polished painterly 3D concept rendering, sophisticated warm natural light, convincing miniature materials and weight, rich but restrained color, crisp readable hero silhouettes and useful construction detail. Treat ceramic mugs, teaspoons, tea bags and wood grain as full human-size scale anchors. Aircraft are approximately 10–22 cm, NOT full-size aircraft in a miniature room. No UI, no watermarks, no logos, no combat, no anthropomorphic faces. Proposed equipment must attach to believable hardpoints with clear rotor and cargo paths. Deliver a generous landscape image at highest available detail.
Cinematic key art: low three-quarter view across a sunlit oak kitchen table. A navy-bellied ivory micro utility helicopter with thin red stripe, bulbous glazed cockpit, two-blade main rotor, long boom, tail rotor and silver skids hovers above a sage ceramic mug, its single brass belly hook supporting a taut white string and ONE rectangular porous tea bag half submerged in amber tea. Warm steam bends under rotor wash; ripples and droplets explain the action. A small olive-drab tandem-rotor transport waits on a cork coaster in the middle distance, and an orange skeletal Skycrane with green stripe, belly tank and long snorkel approaches a milk crock farther back. All three are distinct, NOT fused. The hero bag, string, hook, liquid contact and two-blade rotor are visually unambiguous. Cottage kitchen, sage cabinetry, linen runner, brown teapot, soft garden through open window. Camera at mug-rim height, dynamic but calm precision, broad clear composition, no text.
